info.title: SocialSpree ChatGPT Publishing, Cloudinary & Scheduling API
info.description: Enables ChatGPT to generate images, auto-upload/transcode media to permanent Cloudinary CDN (res.cloudinary.com), and simultaneously schedule or publish posts to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, and YouTube.

get.summary: List Connected Social Accounts & Workspace Info
get.description: Retrieves all active social media accounts (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube), connected slots, and media vault status for the user's SocialSpree workspace.

200.description: Active social accounts and workspace configuration

post.summary: Upload Media to Cloudinary or Schedule/Publish Post
post.description: Dual-mode action: (1) Auto-uploads any image URL, DALL-E asset, or generated AI image to Cloudinary CDN and immediately schedules it to social channels; OR (2) When action='upload_media', uploads to Cloudinary and returns the direct postable public CDN URL.

action.description: Set to 'schedule_post' (default) to schedule to social networks, or 'upload_media' to only upload/generate to Cloudinary CDN.

caption.description: The post text, hashtags, mentions, and call-to-action.

imageUrl.description: Direct public image URL or DALL-E generated URL. SocialSpree will auto-upload and mirror this to permanent Cloudinary CDN.

generateImagePrompt.description: Optional prompt to generate a new AI image with DALL-E 3, auto-upload to Cloudinary, and schedule in a single step.

mediaUrls.description: List of image URLs for single or carousel posts.

imageBase64.description: Optional Base64 encoded image string (e.g. data:image/png;base64,...).

targetChannels.description: List of platforms to publish to: ['instagram', 'facebook', 'linkedin', 'x', 'twitter', 'tiktok', 'youtube'] or specific account IDs. Omit to target all connected active channels.

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for scheduling (e.g. 2026-08-30T18:00:00Z). Omit or set to past/null to publish immediately.

publishNow.description: Set to true to dispatch to social platforms immediately, or false to schedule for later.

title.description: Optional title for the image asset when saving to SocialSpree Media Vault.

200.description: Post scheduled or media uploaded successfully

400.description: Bad Request or Invalid Media URL (e.g. HTML conversation share link provided instead of direct image)

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing SocialSpree API key

500.description: Internal Server Error or Cloudinary Upload Error
